name: Disappointed Parent
description: Not mad. Just disappointed. Wear a jacket.

storm.head: Stay inside. I mean it.
storm.sub: And unplug the computer. Yes, I know you have stuff to do.

storm.head: Don't you dare go out in that.
storm.sub: Lightning doesn't care how busy you are.

snow.head: Wear a hat or I swear to God.
snow.sub: And real boots. Not those sneakers with the holes in them.

snow.head: Text me when you get there.
snow.sub: It's snowing. Drive slow. I'm not sleeping until you text me.

rain.head: Take an umbrella. Now.
rain.sub: No, I don't care that it 'ruins the look.' Wet looks worse.

rain.head: Don't come home soaked again.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance of rain. I'm not doing your laundry this time.

drizzle.head: It's drizzling. Hood up.
drizzle.sub: Your hair does not look good wet. I say this with love.

fog.head: Headlights on, sweetie.
fog.sub: It's foggy as hell. And put the damn phone down while driving.

windy.head: Tie your hair back.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. And bring the patio chairs in, I asked you twice.

scorching.head: Drink some water. WATER.
scorching.sub: Not that energy drink crap. {temp} out there.

scorching.head: Sunscreen. Did you put on sunscreen?
scorching.sub: I can tell you didn't. Go back inside and do it.

hot.head: Did you drink water today?
hot.sub: {temp}. Your body is 60% water and you're acting like it's 6%.

freezing.head: Where is your coat?
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. You will catch your death. Don't argue.

freezing.head: Put on a damn jacket. I'm not asking.
freezing.sub: And gloves. I bought you gloves. Where are the gloves?

cold.head: Bring a sweater.
cold.sub: You always say you're fine and then you're cold. {temp} out there.

cold.head: You're going out like THAT?
cold.sub: High of {high}. Go put on a real jacket.

nice.head: Go outside. Get some sun.
nice.sub: It's lovely out. You look pale, honey.

nice.head: Why are you inside?
nice.sub: {temp} and beautiful. Go touch grass, I'm serious.

meh.head: It's fine. Bring a jacket anyway.
meh.sub: You never know. I'm just saying.

meh.head: Kinda gray. Call your grandmother.
meh.sub: Perfect day for it. She asks about you.

clearNight.head: Why are you still up?
clearNight.sub: It's late. The weather will still be there tomorrow. Go to bed.
